== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 3)]], showing the '''PC-E3''' game text (the PC website card list). No published image shows this text. Other versions: [[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7)]] (original), [[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2), [[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4) and [[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 5)]] (PC-E5, the current text).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] (Internet Archive). The card list prints “once per turn,” twice. Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E3 text:''' “While 'communing': you may not deploy [Maintenance] cards or [Episode I] Jedi; Rebels of ability < 5 draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and, once per turn, once per turn, may lose 1 Force (or use 2 Force) to place one just forfeited in Used Pile; once per turn, may ▼ a Tatooine battleground (or Obi-Wan's Hut).”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1273_27</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block set mark, copyright line, errata mark E) with the PC-E3 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB7-01-Master_Kenobi-PC-E2-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B12 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
* '''Renamed:''' 11 November 2026 from <code>VB7-01-Master_Kenobi-PC-E2-cardmaker.png</code>: the versions were put in date order (Batch S1, versions ruling of 11 November 2026). The image itself is unchanged.
